author: Edge
text:
My friend, welcome. Please do not take this the wrong way but one of
RTMs greatest assets is the membership base. There are some great people
 here. I suggest you take any student who is kind enough to offer their
views (right or wrong) and undertake some screen time. We are all here
to help each other. Of course us students dont have the skill set of the
 masters but please be assured by only asking IF to reply goes against
the spirit of RTM (this is only my opinion) There is only one IF and he
is a very busy man, who I happen to be very fond of. Im sure our other
friends will be willing to give you some insight. I can tell you that IF
 will come along and provide guidance when he thinks you may need it. In
 the meantime any of us would be happy to help.

P.S - We also have a mascot here, I think its Harrys crocodile he may
have smuggled back to Greece from Aus. We dont want the croc to make an
appearance, but I suspect if people start putting conditions on who can
answer, he may well make an appearance.

Im sure there was no malice in your request, nor is there in my reply. Look forward to seeing you around the forum

author: HCDE
text:
Hi If,

I took some time to go through your RTM journal once again and was thinking about you.

I hope you're doing ok with the health issue you mentionned earlier.

Going through your journal was a true journey, and i must say a word about it.

As you go through it, you jump from little trading gems to moments of
anger, moments of joy, of desperation. You have to endure the
interventions of some true buggers (Harsh something...) which throw
black / yellow / pink overcrowded charts that make no sense. You go from
 political to philisophical discussions...

You endure the litany of peoples who give their opinion on matters that just doesn't concern them.

I think i kind of lived in 3 days what you lived in 3 years!

Only one thing is constant in all that: your patience to answer almost
everyone in a respectful manner, even the most stupid ones, like if you
cared that everyone is treated fairly even if they don't deserve it by
their daily actions. That's a rare thing nowadays and i really
appreciate it.

I hope Life is treating you fairly too right now

Wish you the best.

If we have, and our little kink crosses it, then we have tg hit.

If not, we're set for a ride down

author: josh1125
text:
IF,

How do you distinguish between an important LS and one that is not as important? It seems like there are so many LS.

author: Ifmyante
text:
Good question!

The more times a LS price has bounced, the more important it is.

An LS which was formed as part of a trick, be it a stop hunt or the area with stops beyond, it's important.

If the LS broke a FL, it's important

author: Ifmyante
text:
So

FL1 is given significance by the engulf into space on reaction to it. So, stops beyond.

\sure, lining up with something further left makes it all the stronger, but is not necessary.

If FL2 happens to be of far greater HTF significance, this setup will still work, as the PA is good.

If you'd like to ask about BSZ, kindly draw your question up, and I'll do my best to answer.

An implied flag is the zone between a LS and the H/L to its right.

Above current price, it's drawn from the top of the LSK to the high

Below, from the bottom of the LSK to the low
